title: golden-set/v1 body
description: An agent's golden set: the questions its answers are scored against, one Markdown document per agent, the same shape as a domain-skill — `name` is the agent (domain-skill) id and the document id, `markdown` the author's text. Its `##` sections are 설정 and the four question kinds (일반 지식 · 데이터 설명 · 데이터 연관 · 고도화 분석); each `###` under a kind is one question with `- 이름: 값` fields (src/golden-set.mjs, envelope.mjs semantic check). The consumer is fdc-agent-be-spring GoldenMarkdownTool. Rendered as-is to rendered/golden-set/<name>/GOLDEN.md.

name.description: The agent's domain-skill name = document id = rendered/golden-set/<name>/GOLDEN.md.

markdown.description: The whole golden set as the author wrote it, stored and rendered byte-for-byte.
